title: lamium humile
intro: Lamium humile, commonly known as nettle-leaved dead-nettle or creeping lamium, is a perennial flowering plant in the mint family Lamiaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to provide various health benefits, such as reducing inflammation and alleviating symptoms of colds and flu due to its antiviral and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic effects, which help to soothe digestive issues and relieve muscle cramps. The bioactive constituents of Lamium humile include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
